description: SvGauge in Svelte 5 as a KPI dashboard: radial gauges with coloured threshold bands, a needle that follows a live-updating value with a unit label, a size prop, and a needle-less variant used as a storage tile. Copy-paste ready and themed from the tokens.

faq.question: How are the bands defined?
faq.answer: As an array of { from, to, color } objects in the gauge's value range; the demo paints green, amber and red bands for CPU load and the needle animates between values.

faq.question: How do I change the sweep?
faq.answer: sweep sets the arc angle in degrees, a half circle by default and up to a full ring; size sets the pixel diameter and thickness the arc width.

faq.question: Can the gauge have no needle?
faq.answer: Yes. Set needle={false} and the arc fills to the value like a ring, which the storage tile in the demo uses; formatValue controls the readout text.
